verdicts.title: Finite simple characteristic quotients of the free group of rank 2
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we describe how to explicitly construct infinitely many finite simple groups as characteristic quotients of the rank 2 free group $F_2$. This shows that a "baby" version of the Wiegold conjecture fails for $F_2$, and provides counterexamples to two conjectures in the theory of noncongruence subgroups of $\text{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$. verdicts.title: Induced and Coinduced Modules in Cluster-Tilted Algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We propose a new approach to study the relation between the module categories of a tilted algebra $C$ and the corresponding cluster-tilted algebra $B=C\ltimes E$.
